description: This file contains utility functions for AJAX operations, including dynamic dependent dropdown population, service result fetching, UOM conversion check, and timezone initialization, used within a web application.

methods.name: getDependentDropdownValues
methods.description: Dynamically populates a dependent dropdown based on a parent dropdown's value via AJAX, with options for hiding, showing, and input field fallback.

methods.name: getServiceResult
methods.description: Performs a synchronous AJAX POST request to fetch data from a specified service endpoint.

methods.name: prepareAjaxData
methods.description: Prepares AJAX request data from variable arguments, pairing parameter names and values.

methods.name: checkUomConversion
methods.description: Checks if a Unit of Measure conversion exists by calling a service and inspecting the result.

methods.name: initTimeZone
methods.description: Initializes timezoneJS with configuration for timezone data loading, defaulting to North America.
